instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Change one exact piece of text in a text or code file without sending the whole file: give the words to find and the words to put there", and give it file (Path relative to the granted folder); find (The exact text to find; it must occur exactly once in the file); replace (The text to put in its place; may be empty).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:replace-one-piece-of-text-in-a-file and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give file (a path inside the folder the person granted for change), find (the exact text, as it is in the file, newlines and quotes included) and replace (what to put there; empty removes the found text).
